test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of C. A sits second to the left of D. B sits to the immediate right of E. F sits on the extreme right end of the line. How many people sit between B and F?
solution:
Given: Six people, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the right of C. 

2) A sits second to the left of D.

3) B sits to the immediate right of E.

4) F sits on the extreme right end of the line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45203ce9addccb61fda80f4eeaa0c967eb6b55a57a15a3d2c453dbb310bcbbe6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b47b7f762b39dfbcb3d40befe6885de3edf034f5adab672e27300007d66dd4bb.png] 

So, Three people sit between B and F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
